About.title: About the School
About.introBody: Sri Vidhya Nikethan is an English medium school in West Vipparru where children learn beyond textbooks, close to nature.
About.ecoBody: School functions are decorated with leaves and natural materials, and meals are served on paper plates or banana leaves instead of plastic.
About.fieldsBody: Children visit crop fields to see how food, such as rice, is grown, and some lessons are held outdoors.
About.storiesBody: Children read the newspaper every day, and teachers share stories of leaders and how India won its independence.
